leadText:
(Japanese: ヒロシ Hiroshi) is a character of the day who appeared in Curbing the Crimson Tide!. 

He and his friends were confronted by Red Lightning, who challenged them to a Pokémon battle. Despite his friends' warnings, Hiroshi accepted and called out his . Red Lightning won quickly, however, and scribbled on Poliwag's face afterwards. When he took Poliwag to the Pokémon Center, he ran into and , which alerted them to Red Lightning's antics.
